summary: Phase 3 (guided Student create-and-enroll) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py — 20/20 passing (POST /api/students/enroll happy path + enrollment record creation, profile-only, 400 validations for missing/nonexistent class and missing first_name, auth 401/403 including teacher-forbidden, enroll-existing status flip, no raw _id leaks, regression list endpoints). Frontend: Students page, 4-step wizard (both enroll-now and profile-only modes), cascading EnrollmentPicker, enroll-existing dialog, edit FormDialog, delete confirm, search, not-enrolled banner and Class Hub Enrollments regression all verified working. One CRITICAL input bug found and fixed by me: the wizard re-created its Field component on every render, so typing was truncated to a single character per field.

minor.issue: No cascade cleanup: deleting a student leaves its enrollments (and presumably attendance/marks) rows behind. Class Hub Enrollments tab kept showing 8 orphaned rows for deleted students; I purged them so Greenwood is clean (1 student Aarav Shah, 1 enrollment).
Deleting an enrollment does not revert the student's enrollment_status/class_name/section, so the student keeps a stale green 'Enrolled' badge with no enrollment record.
No single-item GET route exists (returns 405); tests must fetch the list. Not a defect per se, just noted for future test authors.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY ME (verified): the inline `const Field = (...) => ...` was redefined on every render, so React remounted the Input on each keystroke and focus jumped to the dialog container — typing 'QAEnrolled' produced only 'Q'. Hoisted to a module-level FieldRow component; char-by-char typing now yields full values in all wizard fields.

action_items: Review my frontend fix in StudentEnrollWizard.jsx (Field -> module-level FieldRow) and apply the same anti-pattern check to any other page defining components inside render.
Add cascade cleanup on student delete (enrollments/attendance/marks) and reset enrollment_status when the last enrollment for a student is deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: Never define a component inside another component's render body (StudentEnrollWizard.Field) — it remounts children each render and breaks input focus. Fixed here.

Enrollment lifecycle is one-way: creation sets students.enrollment_status='enrolled' but deletion of the enrollment/student never reverses or cleans up, allowing stale badges and orphaned enrollment rows.
server.py is ~941 lines and mixes auth, generic /res CRUD, attendance, marks and student enrollment — consider splitting into routers.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the typing bug: StudentEnrollWizard declared `Field` as an arrow component inside the parent component body. Each keystroke updated `form` state, re-rendering the parent and producing a brand-new component type for Field, which React treats as a different element type -> unmount/remount of the <Input>, losing DOM focus after the first character. Repro: open wizard, click First name, type multiple chars slowly -> only the first char persisted and document.activeElement became the dialog. Mitigation applied: hoisted the field renderer to module scope (FieldRow) and passed form/set as props; verified 'Neha'/'Verma'/'QA-501'/'Sunil Verma' now type fully and the create+enroll submission persists correctly.
